name: Classic: Bloodsucking Champions
desc: Double-champion vampire deck. Vladimir (Rn:10) + Allonzo (Rn:9) = highest stats in the game. Heavy combat, frenzy, lots of healing. Mage's Talisman gives Vladimir access to all BSD gifts.

combat_notes.philosophy: VERY damage-heavy combat deck. Get into combat and smash things. That's about as subtle as it gets.
combat_notes.vladimir_synergy: Mage's Talisman → all BSD gifts. Wyrm Hide = healing (+2 Health each, can stack 2x). Patagia/Spiral Boomerang = combat enders.
combat_notes.whip_control: Whip of the Wicked + Eyes of Hate = control what opponent plays. Opponent forced to play block/dodge first.
combat_notes.surprise_ally: Surprise Ally = double firepower OR just draw a card when attacking. Don't waste it.
combat_notes.juicy_johnes: Sacrifice. -2 Gnosis to killer. Send on suicide missions.
combat_notes.frenzy: Frenzy is important for this deck. Not just last resort.

gift_priorities.desc: Consumption of Gaia (Gn:4) — Cancel enemy gifts. Core disruption.
Wyrm Hide (Gn:3) — +2 Health. THIS IS YOUR HEALING. Stack 2x for +4 Health total.
True Fear (Gn:4) — Allonco (Shadow Lords) locks opponent for 1 round. Devastating.
Patagia (Gn:5) — FLY AWAY. Combat ender. Use to escape bad combats.
Horns of the Impaler (Gn:3) — +2 Rage. NOT CRITICAL. Just resilience.
Subjugation of Gaia (Gn:7) — Remove fetish equipment/totems.

equipment_assignments.desc: Mage's Talisman — Vladimir uses ANY gift. ESSENTIAL.
Whip of the Wicked — Opponent FORCED to play block/dodge first. Control tool.
Skin of the Hellbound — Allonco (Hl:7) with armor. Mirror-match friendly.
Spiral Boomerang — COMBAT ENDER. Sends opponent to Umbra for 2 turns.
Skin of the Hellbound — Backup on leader.

combat_event_priorities.desc: Frenzy — IMPORTANT for this deck. Not just last resort. Use to survive AND attack.
Surprise Ally — Double firepower OR just draw a card when attacking. Don't waste.
Taking the Death Blow — Redirect mortal wound.

target_priority.desc: Vladimir regenerates after kill. ALWAYS seek kills.

umbra_strategy.desc: Stay in physical world for combat. Don't enter Umbra.

notes.combo_principal: Vladimir + Mage's Talisman → all BSD gifts. Wyrm Hide x2 = +4 Health (healing). Whip + True Fear = control. Patagia/Spiral Boomerang = combat enders.
notes.healing: Wyrm Hide is your healing. +2 Health each, can stack 2x for +4 Health. Vladimir regenerates after kills. That's your sustain.
notes.combat_enders: Patagia (fly away) and Spiral Boomerang (send to Umbra 2 turns) END combats. Use them to escape bad situations.
notes.surprise_ally_tip: Surprise Ally can be played just to DRAW A CARD when attacking. You don't have to bring in a packmate. Use this for card advantage.
notes.double_champion: Both Vladimir (Rn:10) and Allonco (Rn:9) are champions. Use BOTH aggressively. Don't hide one.
notes.whip_timing: Whip of the Wicked forces opponent to play block/dodge FIRST. Time your attacks around this.
